482	There are aspects that remain fixed in a person, and this is a great gift
483	that cannot be harmed in its existence. It can be refined, one can rise above, one can
484	raise a request in the right way to enlarge those same partzufim called the Holy One, blessed be He,
485	and the Shechinah, Zeir Anpin and Malchut of Atzilut, but in their constancy they are small.
486	In their constancy they are small, meaning that you see, in the person who is in a state of constancy, that he
487	does not raise any special request, he has no request for connection with HaShem, he sees the Holy One, blessed be He, as small.
488	He sees Him as small, and love, the place of unity, he sees only as a point, as a place of longing,
489	as a potential, but he does not live this place of love. Yet he cannot damage this; he
490	acknowledges that there is love, but he does not act toward love and does not live this place of love.
491	But damaging this he cannot, though he can, if he wants, rise higher, refine this place,
492	to grow without being elevated.
493	This is called constancy in the world of Atzilut.
494	With HaShem's help, in the next class we will see the continuation of the connection between these partzufim,
